description:
Update the command reference, the custom-gates guide and the execution-lead skill for reused-verdict provenance that names its source issue, for per-issue gate-run records, and for searches that exclude history files by default.

## Background

The execution-lead skill reads review findings through the glob `.jit/gate-runs/*/result.json` (`.agents/skills/jit-execution-lead/references/lead-review-protocol.md`, `references/rework-prompt-template.md`); under per-issue run records (`gate-runs/<issue-id>/<run-id>.json`) the glob matches nothing, silently. `jit gate status <id> <gate> --all --json` reports an issue's runs of a gate and works on both layouts, so live sessions lose nothing while this repository's tracker stays at format 3.

`docs/how-to/custom-gates.md` and `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` show a reused verdict as `{"derivation": "reused", "source_run": "<run-id>"}`; it also carries `source_issue`. The `jit search` section of `docs/reference/cli-commands.md` says that search covers the event log.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both skill references read findings through `jit gate status <id> <gate> --all --json` and name no gate-run path.
- [hard] REQ-02: Both pages show the reused-verdict shape with `source_issue` and `source_run`.
- [hard] REQ-03: The `jit search` reference no longer says that search covers the event log, states that a search without an explicit file selection excludes history files, and states that an explicit glob can still select them.
title: Gate provenance, gate-run lookup and search docs match per-key reads
